title: credvault provider plugin manifest
description: One JSON file per provider. Mirrors the ProviderSpec fields plus packaging metadata. The loader uses `deny_unknown_fields`, so any key not listed here is a hard error. Secrets never appear here — only the names of the env vars credentials are read from.

manifest_version.description: Envelope schema version. A value newer than the binary understands is refused.

id.description: Canonical provider key — used in /v1/connect/{id} routes, the DB `provider` column, and the encryption AAD. Stable and unique across loaded plugins. By convention matches the file name (`<id>.json`).

version.description: Plugin version (semver recommended). Packaging metadata only; surfaced by discovery, ignored by the engine at runtime.

auth_type.description: `oauth2` drives the redirect/exchange/refresh flow; `api_key` stores a user-supplied long-lived key with no redirect and no refresh.

token_url.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (code exchange + refresh). Required for `oauth2`.

revoke_url.description: Optional RFC 7009 revocation endpoint, called on disconnect. Omit if the provider has none.

client_id_env.description: Name of the env var holding the OAuth client id (or its `_FILE` variant for a mounted secret). Required for `oauth2`.

client_secret_env.description: Name of the env var holding the OAuth client secret (or its `_FILE` variant). Required for `oauth2`.

default_scopes.description: Scopes requested when the caller does not specify any.

scope_separator.description: Joins scopes in the authorize URL. Almost always a space; a few providers use a comma.

token_auth_style.description: How client credentials are sent to the token endpoint: `post` (in the form body) or `basic` (HTTP Basic).

token_accept_json.description: Send `Accept: application/json` to the token endpoint (some providers default to form-encoded responses otherwise).

extra_authorize_params.description: Additional query parameters appended to the authorize URL, as [key, value] pairs (e.g. [["access_type","offline"],["prompt","consent"]]).

token_path.description: Dotted path to the access token in the token response.

refresh_token_path.description: Dotted path to the refresh token in the token response.

expires_in_path.description: Dotted path to the lifetime (seconds) in the token response.

refresh_token_rotates.description: True if the provider issues a new refresh token on each refresh (the stored token is then replaced).

uses_pkce.description: Drive the authorization-code flow with PKCE (RFC 7636, S256). Required by some providers (e.g. X/Twitter); harmless elsewhere.
